blocks.text: “Eva, you are right: forced disarmament through fear is not peace, it is a truce under coercion. If we open the silos now without transforming their conscience, they will go back to forging spears before the engines have cooled. The true key is not handed over by returning the nuclear buttons, but by compelling them to negotiate face to face, without the shield of the machines of war. If they want to regain control of their arsenals, they will have to sign the absolute prohibition of manufacturing them under the custody of the citizens. Freedom without weapons demands maturity; if they choose the metal, the world stops once more.”
